_howToTranslate: Interface text for Live Transmog, one entry per string.
"footer.apply_all": {
"en":    "Apply All",                   <- the original English
"where": "Bottom button row - button",  <- where it appears on screen
"text":  ""                             <- the translation goes here
Fill in "text". "en" and "where" are there to translate against; the mod reads neither, and
a key the mod does not use is ignored.
To add a language, copy a whole block under "locales", change its tag and "endonym" (the
language's name in itself, such as Deutsch), blank every "text", and translate. The tag must be
one the language pack uses: eng, kor, jpn, rus, tur, spa-es, spa-mx, fre, ger, ita, pol,
por-br, zho-tw, zho-cn, ara.
Rules:
- An empty "text" shows the English, so a partial translation is fine.
- Keep every %s, %d, %u, %.2f and so on, in the same order as the English. An entry whose
placeholders do not match is rejected and shows the English.

- Keep the 
 line breaks roughly where they are. They control how tooltips wrap.
- Do not put ## in the text. Button ids are attached by the mod.
- A key ending in .tip is a hover tooltip. Keys ending .one and .many are singular and plural.
- Technical terms stay as they are: prefab, token, SlotPopulator, INI key names.
To contribute one: https://github.com/tkhquang/CrimsonDesertTools/blob/main/CrimsonDesertLiveTransmog/README.md#contributing-a-translation

character.apply_to_selected.where: Top of the Transmog tab - checkbox

character.apply_to_selected.tip.en: When ticked, picking another character in the dropdown (and subsequent picker / slot edits while pinned) applies the preset to THAT character's body, if they are loaded. Engine equip events still render the controlled character's transmog as normal. Untick to restore the legacy cross-body behavior where the controlled body wears the selected character's preset items.
character.apply_to_selected.tip.text: 勾选后，在下拉框中选择其他角色，以及固定期间的槽位编辑，都会尽量应用到该角色的身体上（需要该角色已加载）。引擎的装备事件仍会照常渲染受控角色的幻化。取消勾选则恢复旧的跨身体行为。

character.body_kind.where: Top of the Transmog tab - dropdown

character.body_kind.tip.en: Override the body type used for picker filtering. Use if you run a body-swap mod that changes this character's skeleton (e.g. Kliff -> Female).
character.body_kind.tip.text: 覆盖选择器筛选所用的体型。如果你安装了会改变角色骨架的换体模组（例如把 Kliff 换成女性），可以在这里手动指定。

character.picker.where: Top of the Transmog tab - label

character.picker.tip.en: Pick a different character to edit their preset while controlling someone else. The controlled body will wear the picked character's preset items (cross-body apply - partial coverage expected).
character.picker.tip.text: 在控制当前角色的同时，选择另一个角色来编辑他的预设。受控身体会穿上所选角色的预设物品（跨身体应用，通常只有部分生效）。

character.pinned.tip.en: Editing pinned: this character's preset is loaded into the slot rows, but the body on screen is whoever you control in-game. Cross-body apply - some items (gender-specific, weapons) may not render. Pick the controlled character to unpin.
character.pinned.tip.text: 编辑已固定：所选角色的预设已载入槽位行，但画面上的身体仍是你在游戏中控制的角色。跨身体应用时，部分物品（性别限定、武器等）可能不会渲染。选回受控角色即可取消固定。

character.unpin.where: Top of the Transmog tab - button

character.unpin.tip.en: Drop the editing pin and follow the controlled character again.
character.unpin.tip.where: Top of the Transmog tab - tooltip
character.unpin.tip.text: 取消编辑固定，重新跟随当前受控角色。

color.advanced_view.tip.en:
Show per-region per-token trees with full
shader-property granularity beneath the
merchant-like flat picker list.

Default off - most users get the same UX
as the merchant dye UI: one picker per
distinct asset-default color. Tick this
only if you need to dye individual tokens
(e.g. tint vs. mask vs. detail layers
separately).
color.advanced_view.tip.text:
在商人式扁平列表下方，按区域与 token 展开
树状视图，提供完整的着色器属性粒度。

默认关闭：多数用户只需与商人染色界面相同
的方式，即每种资源默认色对应一个选择器。
只有需要单独给 tint、mask、detail 等图层染色
时才勾选。

color.link_channels.tip.en:
When ON: pick one color, all present R/G/B channel-suffix
Properties get it (merchant behavior).
Untick to edit each channel independently.
color.link_channels.tip.text:
开启时：选定一个颜色，所有带 R/G/B 通道后缀的
属性都会同步应用（与商人染色一致）。
关闭后可逐个通道独立编辑。

color.modified_only.tip.en:
Hide rows / regions whose color is
still at the captured engine default.
Untick to see every swatch this slot
exposed during apply.
color.modified_only.tip.text:
隐藏颜色仍停留在捕获时引擎默认值的行与区域。
取消勾选可查看该槽位在应用时暴露出的全部色板。

color.no_apply_yet.tip.en:
No apply yet - swatches unknown.
Run Re-init to capture the slot's dye
swatches before toggling the master Dye
switch.
color.no_apply_yet.tip.text:
尚未应用：色板未知。
请先运行“重新初始化”捕获该槽位的染色
色板，再切换主染色开关。

color.reinit.tip.en:
Single clear + apply (~1.5s) to capture
the slot's swatches. Use when the list
looks empty or stale.

Replaces the manual 'untick / retick'
loop - you can leave this slot alone
while it runs.
color.reinit.tip.text:
执行一次“清除 + 应用”（约 1.5 秒）以捕获
该槽位的色板。列表为空或已过期时使用。

可以代替手动的“取消勾选 / 重新勾选”流程，
运行期间无需操作该槽位。

color.reset_slot.tip.en:
Wipe ALL captured swatches for THIS slot.
Use when cross-slot bleed has misattributed
rows from another transmog item (common with
Kairos and other shared-material sets).

Triggers a fresh apply on this slot, which
re-captures cleanly. Loses any colors you have
picked for this slot.
color.reset_slot.tip.text:
清除本槽位已捕获的全部色板。
当跨槽位串色把其他幻化物品的行错误归到这里
时使用（Kairos 等共用材质的套装较常见）。

它会在该槽位触发一次新的应用并重新干净地
捕获，但你为该槽位选定过的颜色会丢失。

color.reset_slot_top.tip.en:
Wipe ALL captured swatches for THIS slot,
clear the post-reinit lock + frozen-hidden
rows, then trigger a fresh apply.

Use when the slot is stuck with stale rows
(e.g. JSON-restored entries that no longer
match the current item) and Re-init cannot
make progress.
color.reset_slot_top.tip.text:
清除本槽位已捕获的全部色板，解除重新初始化
后的锁定与冻结隐藏行，然后触发一次新的应用。

当槽位卡在过期的行上（例如从 JSON 恢复、但
已不匹配当前物品的条目），而重新初始化又无
法推进时使用。

color.revert.tip.en:
Revert ALL user overrides on THIS slot
back to engine defaults. Keeps the
captured swatch list intact (no Re-init
needed afterwards).

Use to compare your dye picks against
the original asset colors, or to undo
a slot's color edits without losing
the captured row structure.
color.revert.tip.text:
把本槽位的全部用户覆盖恢复为引擎默认值，
并保留已捕获的色板列表（之后无需重新初始化）。

可用来对比你的染色选择与资源原始颜色，或在
不丢失已捕获行结构的前提下撤销槽位颜色编辑。

dye.mirror_mod0.text: 将 0 号染槽镜像到全部

dye.mods_range.tip.en:
Tip: items typically use mods (dye slots) 1-12; rest no-ops.
This mod cannot tell which item is dyeable or has many slots.
dye.mods_range.tip.text:
提示：物品通常只使用 1-12 号染槽，其余无效。
本模组无法判断某件物品能否染色，也无法得知它有多少个染槽。

dye.recommit.tip.en:
Re-tick this slot once so color
overrides commit. Use if a color
edit did not take.
dye.recommit.tip.text:
重新勾选一次该槽位，让颜色覆盖提交。
颜色编辑没有生效时可以试试这个。

dye.sparse.tip.en:
Sparse (default, matches the merchant dye UI):
emit only the channels you set; engine paints
the rest with its own defaults.

Turn off for cross-class fake transmog where
every channel needs your color to suppress
the carrier's default palette.
dye.sparse.tip.text:
稀疏（默认，与商人染色界面一致）：
只发送你设置过的通道，其余交给引擎用自己的
默认值填充。

跨类别伪幻化时请关闭：那种情况下每个通道都
需要你的颜色，才能压过载体的默认调色板。

dye.sync_from_live.tip.en:
Re-read this slot's dye from the engine's
current auth table and overwrite the
preset's saved channels. Use after you
apply dye at an in-game dye station and
want those bytes saved into this preset
without re-running Capture Outfit.

No-op if the slot has no live auth-table
entry (nothing equipped) or no dye records.
dye.sync_from_live.tip.text:
从引擎当前的授权表重新读取该槽位的染色，
并覆盖预设中已保存的通道。适用于你在游戏
内的染色台染色之后，想把这些数据存进本预
设，又不想重新运行“捕获当前装备”的情况。

如果槽位没有实时授权表条目（未装备任何物
品）或没有染色记录，则不会有任何动作。

slots.weapon_experimental.tip.en:
EXPERIMENTAL.

Best practice: pick a transmog from the
SAME weapon family you have equipped.
Sword on a sword, spear on a spear, 1H
on a 1H, 2H on a 2H - always renders
correctly, drawn or sheathed.

Why the limit exists:
Each weapon prefab carries its own
bone-binding and attachment-socket data
(which bone it parents to, which socket
transform it uses, hand offsets, sheath
pose). The engine looks those bindings
up from the REAL equipped item's class -
not from this transmog target - so a
mismatched-class swap lands in the wrong
socket and goes invisible.

Examples:
 - 2H prefab while a 1H is equipped:
   mesh shows on the back; the real 1H
   goes invisible when drawn.
 - Spear/hammer prefab while a sword is
   equipped: invisible when drawn
   (sheathed on back still renders).
 - Same family (sword<->sword, etc.):
   renders correctly in every pose.
slots.weapon_experimental.tip.text:
实验性功能。

建议：只在你已装备的同类武器中挑选幻化。
剑换剑、枪换枪、单手换单手、双手换双手，
无论拔出还是收起都能正确显示。

为什么会有这个限制：
每个武器 prefab 都自带骨骼绑定与挂点数据
（挂在哪根骨骼、使用哪个挂点变换、手部
偏移、收鞘姿态）。引擎是按你真正装备的
那件武器的类别去查这些绑定的，而不是按
幻化目标，所以跨类别替换会落到错误的挂
点上并变得不可见。

示例：
 - 装备单手时选用双手 prefab：
   网格显示在背后，拔出时真正的单手武器
   反而不可见。
 - 装备剑时选用枪/锤 prefab：
   拔出时不可见（收在背后仍会显示）。
 - 同类互换（剑换剑等）：
   各姿态都能正确显示。

slots.weapon_experimental_tools.tip.en:
EXPERIMENTAL.

Heads-up: in this game, tools (pickaxe,
mallet, etc.) share the same engine slot
as 2H weapons. Setting a transmog here
may also affect the tool you have
equipped. Investigation ongoing.

Best practice: pick a transmog from the
SAME weapon family you have equipped.
Sword on a sword, spear on a spear, 1H
on a 1H, 2H on a 2H - always renders
correctly, drawn or sheathed.

Why the limit exists:
Each weapon prefab carries its own
bone-binding and attachment-socket data
(which bone it parents to, which socket
transform it uses, hand offsets, sheath
pose). The engine looks those bindings
up from the REAL equipped item's class -
not from this transmog target - so a
mismatched-class swap lands in the wrong
socket and goes invisible.

Examples:
 - 2H prefab while a 1H is equipped:
   mesh shows on the back; the real 1H
   goes invisible when drawn.
 - Spear/hammer prefab while a sword is
   equipped: invisible when drawn
   (sheathed on back still renders).
 - Same family (sword<->sword, etc.):
   renders correctly in every pose.
slots.weapon_experimental_tools.tip.text:
实验性功能。

注意：本作中的工具（镐、锤等）与双手武器
共用同一个引擎槽位。在这里设置幻化可能
也会影响你装备的工具。仍在调查中。

建议：只在你已装备的同类武器中挑选幻化。
剑换剑、枪换枪、单手换单手、双手换双手，
无论拔出还是收起都能正确显示。

为什么会有这个限制：
每个武器 prefab 都自带骨骼绑定与挂点数据
（挂在哪根骨骼、使用哪个挂点变换、手部
偏移、收鞘姿态）。引擎是按你真正装备的
那件武器的类别去查这些绑定的，而不是按
幻化目标，所以跨类别替换会落到错误的挂
点上并变得不可见。

示例：
 - 装备单手时选用双手 prefab：
   网格显示在背后，拔出时真正的单手武器
   反而不可见。
 - 装备剑时选用枪/锤 prefab：
   拔出时不可见（收在背后仍会显示）。
 - 同类互换（剑换剑等）：
   各姿态都能正确显示。
